info.name: AlexH's Google Voice Dark 11/2026
info.description: NOW UPDATED FOR November 2026.  It's more complete than most dark mode scripts out there (so long as Google doesn't break something), and does its best to fit in with all of their other official dark mode web application offerings.
info.additionalInfo: A functional and up-to-date dark theme for Google Voice, as of November 2026. All functionality should be included (SMS, voicemail, VoIP calls, archived messages, etc.). This theme matches the style of the current official "light" theme of Google Voice and should immediately be familiar to you if you have used the default Google Voice web interface... Now you can simply enjoy it in a clean and easy on the eyes dark mode.
